$why: A FRAGMENT of the detective prompt, 2026-08-16.
The tracker's issue type is a HINT and the prompt says so in both directions. Both texts
exist because the wrong-way error is asymmetric: told it is a defect when it is not, the
agent hunts for a bug that was never there; told it is not when it is, it designs a feature
over a broken behaviour. Two fragments, so neither can be lost by editing the other.
body: \nJIRA CLASSIFIES THIS AS A DEFECT (issue type: Bug). This is a HINT, not a certainty — if the ticket's own text below clearly describes a capability that does not exist yet rather than broken existing behavior, trust the ticket over this hint. Assuming defect: there IS an existing bug and an existing symptom. Your job is the CAUSE, not the symptom (see CORE PRINCIPLE below).\n
description: Told to the detective when the tracker classifies the story as a defect.
